**B) Amorphous fibronectin deposits in APOE ε3/ε3 astrocytes and fibrillar, thread-like deposits in APOE ε4/ε4 astrocytes**

In studies using isogenic human iPSC-derived astrocytes to model gliovascular dysfunction in Alzheimer's disease, APOE ε4/ε4 astrocytes were found to produce fibronectin deposits with a **fibrillar, thread-like morphology**, whereas APOE ε3/ε3 astrocytes produced **amorphous fibronectin deposits**. This altered fibronectin organization in APOE ε4/ε4 astrocytes has been associated with disrupted perivascular homeostasis and is considered a contributor to the vascular dysfunction observed in Alzheimer's disease.
